summary: Concurrent-writer correctness requires exact effects, zero escaped busy on the accepted population, fifteen base scenarios, and one unpaced 1000-write ten-process population. D5 retires ten-process latency measurement, falsifier, control, pacing, status, and their tests, including CD-0051 and CD-0057. Unrelated read P99, durability/recovery, and runtime transaction behavior remain; CD-0011 owns storage-authority reopen conditions.
title: Concurrent writers preserve exact effects without escaped busy failures
